execution_model: Independent host batches, each preserving its own summary and source freeze. No single-round-15 claim.
source_storage: Every frozen source is either a verbatim text snapshot or an exact baseline commit/path/blob/SHA reference. Sensitive baseline source bodies are not republished; actual artifacts have zero scanning exceptions.
preparation_and_fonts: Each supplied batch must cover 105 preparation dependencies and 23 official font sources, including actual display wrapper and reviewed manifest. Seventeen named probes plus shared rtc_probe.py yield eighteen packaged Python files.
preparation_origin: Historical preparation-time NOT RUN/BLOCKED fields remain unchanged; normalization receipts label origins rather than rewriting them.
visual_limit: Actual final frame only. Intermediate states, all numeric extrema, every glyph and physical hardware are not inferred from source arithmetic or functional PASS.
